title: 练枪训练 · Viscose S2 Easier

panels.title: 当前清单档位
panels.description: 4 大类 14 子类中最低的那一档（拿 rank 的卡口）

targets.query:
option location = {zone: "Asia/Shanghai", offset: 8h}
from(bucket: "aim") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aim_bench_meta" and r._field == "lowestSubIdx") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> last()

panels.title: 已上榜
panels.description: 已拿到至少 Lemming 的场景数 / 总数

targets.query:
option location = {zone: "Asia/Shanghai", offset: 8h}
from(bucket: "aim") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aim_bench_meta" and r._field == "rankedText") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> last()

panels.title: 卡住的子类
panels.description: 仍在最低档的子类别（需要优先攻）

targets.query:
option location = {zone: "Asia/Shanghai", offset: 8h}
from(bucket: "aim") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aim_bench_meta" and r._field == "stuckText") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> last()

panels.title: 平均离下一档
panels.description: 39 个场景距各自下一档线的平均差距，越小越接近升档

targets.query:
option location = {zone: "Asia/Shanghai", offset: 8h}
from(bucket: "aim") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aim_bench_meta" and r._field == "avgGap") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> last()

panels.title: 档位分布
panels.description: 每个档位上有多少场景（按场景当前档位统计）

targets.query:
option location = {zone: "Asia/Shanghai", offset: 8h}
from(bucket: "aim") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aim_bench_row" and r._field == "rowJson") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "scenario"])
